text: Zoho CRM to ChatGPT? Five ways, not one.
Two bring CRM data into ChatGPT. Three bring OpenAI into Zoho.
One: the Zoho CRM plugin. Install, sign in, ask about your deals.
Two: a Zoho MCP server. You pick every tool it may use.
Three: OpenAI inside Zia, for drafts and summaries in the CRM.
Four: Zoho Flow. A new lead starts an AI step, with no code.
Five: a Deluge function. Your prompt, your fields, your checks.
Whichever you choose, start read-only. Confirm every change.
